summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Phase 2 AI Body Scan. 13/13 backend tests pass (premium gate 403s, full GPT-5.2 Vision analyze flow with real Unsplash body image, schema validation incl. all muscle groups, delta_vs_previous null on first scan and dict on second scan with previous_scan_id linkage, history sort newest-first, detail 200/404, delete returns ok+deleted=1, photo NOT persisted in DB verified directly against body_scans collection). Frontend: non-premium gate renders with crown + 'PREMIUM FEATURE' heading + upgrade button that navigates to /premium; premium admin sees disclaimer banner, notes textarea, 'FOTO HOCHLADEN' upload button, and history section; Dashboard CTA card with data-testid='dashboard-bodyscan-cta' correctly navigates to /bodyscan.

minor.issue: LLM JSON parse failure returns 500 (no fallback). Consistent with existing /api/nutrition/analyze pattern but a 422 with friendlier text would improve UX.
No rate limiting; each call is an expensive GPT-5.2 Vision request and could drain EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget if a premium user spams it.
Returns {ok:true, deleted:0} for non-existent IDs (no 404). Cosmetic - consistent with admin/tickets pattern.
body_scans documents are not purged on user deletion (orphans accumulate). Same pattern as nutrition_entries flagged in iteration_2.

action_items: Optional: extend admin_delete_member to also purge body_scans for the user (mirror activity_events / nutrition_entries gap flagged in iteration_2).
Optional: add LLM-fallback (or 422 with clearer message) on /api/bodyscan/analyze when JSON is unparseable, similar suggestion to /api/coach/adjust-plan.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1849 lines (was 1413). Still well over the 700-line guideline. Body scan, nutrition, coach, sessions, payments all belong in their own routers.
bodyscan_delete returns {ok:true, deleted:0} for unknown IDs (silently succeeds) - consider 404 for symmetry with bodyscan_detail.
Premium gate uses is_premium_active() which silently treats malformed timestamps as 'not premium' (same broad-except concern noted in prior iterations).
No DB index on body_scans.user_id + created_at - history query will degrade once a user has hundreds of scans.
Photo deletion privacy claim ('Dein Foto wird nicht gespeichert') is correctly enforced (verified by direct Mongo inspection) - good.
delta_vs_previous correctly references previous_scan_id and previous_scan_date - enables compare view.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_bodyscan.py (new comprehensive suite: 13 tests covering premium gate, full analyze flow, delta, history/detail/delete, DB-level photo non-persistence check)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 AI Body Scan is fully working end-to-end. Two real GPT-5.2 Vision calls per run (~10s each) so the suite takes ~18s. Vision call may return 400 'no_body_detected' on certain images - tests use Unsplash portraits which work reliably. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_bodyscan.py. The previously-flagged is_premium boolean vs is_premium_active() discrepancy from iteration_2 is still present but not impacting bodyscan since require_premium() correctly uses is_premium_active().
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The non-premium UI test initially failed because newly-registered users are redirected to /onboarding (route guard, expected behavior). Resolved by registering + onboarding via API, then injecting JWT into localStorage to land directly on /bodyscan as a non-premium user with completed onboarding.
